description: Set Impressum fields. Merges: only the keys given change; an empty string clears a field. An unknown key, a value outside a select field's options or an invalid email is refused (400); a checkbox field stores "ja" or empty. Needs an imported Impressum library (409 otherwise). Regenerates every generated document and returns the new state as legal_get_facts does. Requires cvrt-legal 0.7.0+.

facts.description: field key => value, keys as legal_get_facts lists them

name: legal_put_facts
